body: Founder, real-time: 'QWER animation frames need to indicate visually if an ability is ready to cast or not.' Root cause: ArenaSnapshotMsg never carried cooldown/mp state, so net_mode (server-authoritative) left the local player's own q/w/r_cooldown_ms and mp zeroed forever -- the S170-127 ability-tile HUD rendered every ability as permanently ready in the one mode (real online play) that matters. Fixed by syncing cooldown+mp over the wire and adding a mana_blocked visual state alongside the existing cooldown wipe/countdown. Verified: build.sh + build_arena.sh clean, full headless suite passing, live server+2-bot match over the real network path with the larger snapshot struct. REDGARDEN 6846b33.
title: Q/W/E ability tiles reflect real cooldown+mana readiness in net_mode
